newsitem.title: USA: TWA launches summer discounts to Europe.
newsitem.headline: TWA launches summer discounts to Europe.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday it had launched a summer fare sale with discounts of up to 40 percent on travel to four European cities and the Dominican Republic.
The fares are valid from 71 cities in the United States to Lisbon, London, Milan, Rome and Santo Domingo.
Certain travel restrictions apply, and a Saturday night stay is required.
A round-trip ticket from New York to Santo Domingo, for example, is now priced at $298, down from $419 previously. St. Louis to London is $698, down from $1,022.
